fixesOpened.title: Stop Latent from lingering in the Dynamic Island after you close the app
fixesOpened.reporter: Steven (@starz), in-app bug, build 1.0.6 (39), iOS 26.6.1, Oct 16 5:29 PM PT
fixesOpened.whatItFixes: Latent's session pill could stay in the Dynamic Island after the session ended or the app was closed, and it blocked other apps' Live Activities. Now the pill goes away as soon as a session ends (saved, discarded, recovered, or signed out), any leftover pill is cleared whenever you open Latent outside a session, and a running pill expires on its own if the app gets killed.
fixesOpened.howToCheck: Start a session, then end it an awkward way (discard it, swipe Latent away in the app switcher, or sign out): the pill should disappear within a second or two. Start another session and switch to another app: the pill should stay while the session runs. Open Latent when you're not in a session: any leftover pill should clear.

fixesOpened.title: Make “Edit tags…” on your profile open the tag editor
fixesOpened.reporter: migue (@m1guelch), in-app bug, build 1.0.6 (39), iOS 26.5.2, Oct 17 1:50 AM PT
fixesOpened.whatItFixes: On your profile, “Edit tags…” in the tag filter menu looked tappable, but taps fell through to the chart underneath. Even when a tap landed, iOS 26 dropped the editor because it opened at the same moment the menu closed. Now the tap reaches the button and the editor opens right after the menu closes. Nothing new was built; it just reaches the tag editor that already exists.
fixesOpened.howToCheck: Open You, tap the sliders chip at the end of the tag row, then tap “Edit tags…”: the tag editor should slide up. Add, rename, or delete a tag and tap Done; the profile chips should update. Holding a tag chip and tapping Edit tag should open the same editor.

fixesOpened.title: Don't send people to Settings when there's no Camera switch
fixesOpened.reporter: “Camera Access” email to support@, Oct 16 9:28 AM PT (sender address hidden)
fixesOpened.whatItFixes: iPhone only shows a Camera switch under Settings › Latent after the app has asked for the camera once, and hides it when Screen Time blocks the camera. Latent treated both cases like “they said no” and sent people to a Settings page with nothing to turn on. Now it shows the normal Allow prompt if it hasn't asked yet, says plainly when Screen Time is blocking the camera, and only opens Settings after someone tapped Don't Allow.
fixesOpened.howToCheck: On a real iPhone, delete and reinstall Latent and open Record: you should see “Turn on camera” and the iOS Allow prompt, not Open Settings. Tap Don't Allow, then Open Settings: Settings › Latent should now list Camera. With Screen Time › Content & Privacy Restrictions › Camera set to Don't Allow, Record should show a short message and no Settings button.

carriedFromYesterday.title: Stop the video-link retry loop when a clip can't stream
carriedFromYesterday.reporter: PostHog “Edge function loop” alert (fired Oct 16 at 217/hr), build 39 phones on flaky cellular
carriedFromYesterday.whatItFixes: On a flaky connection, a clip that couldn't stream kept asking our server for a video link every few seconds, for hours. Now, after a failure, the app waits before asking again (1 minute, doubling up to 10) and tries right away once the phone is back online or you scroll the post away and back. Malcolm's merged #532 already handles fully offline phones; his note says merge both.
carriedFromYesterday.howToCheck: On cellular or weak signal, leave a friend's clip that hasn't finished loading on screen. Turn airplane mode on for a minute, then off: within a few seconds the clip should play without force-quitting. Scrolling the post away and back should also retry.
